review.scope_control: Repairs were limited to observed pathologies from live-style runtime conversations.
review.sandbox_boundary: Existing RC3 sandbox foundation was design-only, so DELTA 1.3 added a small governed experiment harness that records isolated experiment evidence without mutating production code.
review.architecture_growth: No new discourse layer, provider path, retrieval adapter, scheduler, memory store, or authority model was added.
review.routing_precedence: Governed-development workflow and governance-local recovery evidence now preempt broad concept retrieval only for narrow observed cases.
review.working_memory: Explicit subject anchors and developer-overlay stripping reduce topic-anchor pollution without hidden persistence.
review.render_correction: Render correction remains local, ephemeral, and barred from provider calls, retrieval, and memory formation.
review.stale_tests: Obsolete assertions expecting automatic memory candidates or exact concept-browse wording were updated to match governed behavior.
remaining_limitations: Live validation used the actual router/render path rather than full manual Tkinter clicking.
Responses remain deterministic and local; English polish is intentionally secondary to routing and governance maturity.
The sandbox harness records and evaluates hypotheses but does not create containers, VMs, or external execution environments.
